items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: And Jimmy Plannan was on there, you know.

ctx.x: So that became his boy, and that was his boy at the point. Yeah, well, yeah. Cause he really, I think he really thought he put a lot of time into the class. I know he did. And because of it, a lot of his other artists suffered. You know, Neely Smith suffered and a lot of other people. Suffered. You only did that one record before he put you out of the day? Yeah. Yeah.
I, uh, that's the, that was the only thing I did. And, uh, I, uh, did this, this, uh, this, this album, you know. And Jimmy Plannan was on there, you know.
What's some of the big places that you played when you were on tour?
